summary: Iteration 3 features tested: (1) admin match_time input on contest create/edit (2) user countdown with per-second ticking, 'Match started' + disabled join for past match_time, no countdown for contests without match_time (3) backend blocks POST /api/entries when contest match_time is in past with 400 'Entries closed: match already started' (4) WhatsApp share popup opens with encoded contest title, entry fee, prize pool, and origin/?contest=<id>. Light regression: creating and editing contests without match_time still works. All 6 backend match_time tests passed; frontend flows verified via Playwright.

design_issues.screen: User contest card - WhatsApp share text
issues: The cricket emoji 🏏 in the share text is encoded as %EF%BF%BD (Unicode replacement char) in the popup URL. Likely the source file has the emoji stored/rendered as U+FFFD. Text still contains title/fees/link correctly, but the intended 🏏 shows as � on WhatsApp preview. Minor cosmetic.
Console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Landing).' Not a blocker but should be looked at - likely a setState inside render in Landing.
Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent.' Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional) Fix mangled cricket emoji in ContestCard.share() text - source appears to contain U+FFFD instead of 🏏.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to shadcn dialogs to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend create_entry uses datetime.fromisoformat with a naive fallback but future date parsing works. The try/except swallows ValueError silently, which means malformed match_time would allow entries — acceptable but consider stricter parsing.

useCountdown formats display as 'Xd Yh Zm' when d>0 (no seconds). Requirement says 'ticking each second' - value ticks internally but display only changes each minute for >1 day. Verified per-second ticking for < 1 day (01:59:52 -> 01:59:51). Acceptable UX.
window.open uses 'https://wa.me/?text=...' but WhatsApp redirects popup URL to api.whatsapp.com/send/. Content preserved.
seed_data_creation: Created temp contests TEST_UI_Future, TEST_UI_NoTime, TEST_UI_Past, TEST_UI_NearHours during UI tests; deleted at end. Backend tests use TEST_ prefix and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 3 features (admin match_time input, countdown ticking, past-match entry block 400, WhatsApp share popup) verified. Minor cosmetic: cricket emoji corrupted to U+FFFD in share text; not a blocker.
